CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  June 20, 2022

 The audio and video recordings of the meeting are available here: PC Meeting – June 20, 2022
  (Audio).m4a / PC Meeting – June 20, 2022 (Video).mp4

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia

  Absent:  Gardea

  Mojarro arrived at 7:11 P.M.

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner;
  Marlene Vega, Contract Planner; Alondra Espinosa, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by Vice President Garcia

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – JUNE 6, 2022 (7:02 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the June 6, 2022, Regular Meeting of the Alhambra
  Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the June 6, 2022, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Mojarro, Gardea

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

  1
  06/20/2022
 F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-04, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-22-02 & VARIANCE VAR-22-01 (7:03 P.M.)
  • 2142 South Fremont Avenue
  • Applicant: Michael Medina
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit,
  Conditional Use Permit and Variance to establish a martial arts studio
  in a lease space previously used as a medical office on an
  approximate land area of 36,643 square feet located in the CPD
  (Commercial Planned Development) zone. The Variance is
  requested to reduce the number of required on-site parking spaces.
  (This application is exempt from the California Environmental Quality
  Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Continue to July 18, 2022.
  • Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  • Michael Medina, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue Agenda Item 2 to July 18, 2022.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Mojarro, Gardea

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-53 (7:09 P.M.)
  • 1515 South Eighth Street
  • Applicant: Eugene Tzeng
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  to construct a new 800 square foot, rear unit with an attached two-
  car garage behind an existing house on an approximate land area of
  8,500 square feet located in R-2 (Limited Multiple Family Residential)
  zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 22-20 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-22-53, subject to the Condition of Approval.
  • Contract Planner Marlene Vega provided the Staff presentation.
  • Eugene Tzeng and Charlie Tzeng, the Applicants, were available
  to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 3.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  2
  06/20/2022
   Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Gardea

G.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT:

  •  There was no Director’s Report.

H.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Helen Fong commented on the Conditional Use Permit and noise coming from La
  Chuperia Cantina. (7:18 P.M.)

  •  Anaya Espinosa inquired about Agenda Item 2. She was advised that the Item was
  continued to the July 18, 2022 meeting. (7:24 P.M.)

I.  COMMISSION COMMUNICATIONS/ANNOUNCEMENTS:

  •  Vice President Garcia inquired about the process of bringing back a Conditional Use
  Permit for consideration, along with the investigation process. (7:30 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Sahu inquired about the investigation and evidence gathering
  process. (7:41 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Olson added her regard for the noise complaint, assuring that it is
  being heard by the Commission and staff. (7:40 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Wang inquired what would constitute “substantial evidence” in this
  case. (7:42 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Juarez requested the staff research if the institute had been cited and
  if they had been provided any exemption in order to get their entitlements. (7:48 P.M.)

  •  Vice President Garcia commented that he’d like to be sure that Code Enforcement
  is responsive to the residents that have legitimate concerns. (8:00 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Olson announced the Alhambra Historical Society is reopening after
  a two-year closure on Saturday, July 2nd. (8:07 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Wang added that the Zoning Code update is coming up and that
  meetings are limited. (8:07 P.M.)

  3
  06/20/2022
 J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:58 P.M. to Monday,
  July 18, 2022, at 7:00 P.M.

  _______________________________
  Chris Olson
  President
ATTEST:

_______________________
Karabeth Garcia
Executive Assistant
